title: Code Graph RAG file tools can read or overwrite files outside the project
summary: Paginated read_file permits out-of-root reads. A separate structural_search and structural_replace flaw follows repository symlinks outside the project, permitting reads and writes when replacement is applied.

severity.rationale: Untrusted repositories or tool arguments can expose files and overwrite data under the process account. The credential and integrity risks warrant 72 hours.

affected.note: Affected through 0.0.586; the earlier fix does not address this flaw.

exposure: MCP or agentic tools processing attacker-influenced paths or repositories containing symlinks are exposed.

remediation.details: Upgrade code-graph-rag to 0.0.587 or later to cover both issues.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
